topic: Teachers and students (ACT, League of Filipino Students) protesting for higher teacher pay and education budget, anti-corruption; rally at Malacanang 4 Oct and march to Mendiola 5 Oct
scale: about 20 protesters at Malacanang, 16 teachers and students reported hurt (ACT); about 100 marched to Mendiola on 5 Oct (Manila Police District)
quote1: Several teachers and students staged a lightning rally inside the Malacañang Complex in San Miguel, Manila, on Sunday morning despite tight security in the area.
quote2: Labing-anim na guro at estudyante umano ang sugatan matapos ang tensiyon sa pagitan ng mga pulis at mga nagpoprotesta sa labas ng Malacañang nitong Linggo, Oktubre 4, ayon sa Alliance of Concerned Teachers (ACT) Philippines.
